sentences.text: As per prosecution story, on 07/04/2021 appellant Shaitan Bai and other co-accused person abducted both the prosecutrix from their house situated at Village Jogakhedi on the pretext of their marriage at some good place.
Thereafter, co-accused Rahul took one of the prosecutrix by Motorcycle to Jaora and on the next date co-accused Kailashnath committed rape upon her.
Rape has also been committed upon another prosecutrix.
Thereafter, Shaitan Bai along with Kailashnath took both the prosecutrix to Alot and they kept them in the house of Bherulal.
Thereafter, one of the prosecutrix has been sold out for a sum of Rs.80,000/- to co-accused Ganpat.
Ganpat has kept the prosecutrix for one and half months and has committed rape upon her.
He again sold the prosecutrix to other co-accused Nagulal in the presence of present appellant for a sale consideration of Rs.1.5 Lacs, where again the prosecutrix was subjected to rape.
Accordingly, offence has been registered against the appellant and other co-accused persons.
Learned counsel for appellants seeks permission to withdraw this criminal appeal in respect of appellant No.1 Shaitan Bai.
Prayer allowed.
Criminal appeal in respect of appellant No.1 Shaitan Bai is accordingly dismissed as withdrawn.

Learned counsel for the appellant/Sumanbai submitted that appellant Sumanbai is in custody since 27.4.2022, investigation is over and charge sheet has been filed, prosecutrix (PW-1) has been examined before the trial court and she deposed against the appellant only that appellant Suman told him that she will arrange her marriage in a best place.

The prosecutrix is a major lady, she went with Ganpat with her own accord, co-accused Govind has been enlarged on bail by this court vide order dated 3.1.2023 passed in Cri.A. No. 12190/2022 in similar circumstances.
Under the above material change in the circumstances, prayer for grant of bail may be considered on such terms and conditions, as this Court deems fit and proper.
Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent / State opposes the appeal and prays for its rejection.
Perused the impugned order of the trial Court as well as the case diary.

After considering all the facts and circumstances of the case, nature and gravity of offence, arguments advanced by the learned counsel for the appellant and also taking note of the fact that prosecutrix (PW-1) has been examined before the trial Court and she has turned hostile in respect of offence related with the present appellant, the allegation levelled against the present appellant Suman is only that she told the prosecutrix that she will arrange her marriage in a best place but prosecutrix did not depose anything against the present appellant for commission of offence, the appellant has already suffered jail incarceration since last 11 months, Vijay (PW-2) has also turned hostile and he has not supported the case of prosecution, co-accused has been enlarged on bail, and final conclusion of the trial will take sufficient long time, in view of the evidence available on record, I deem it proper to release the appellant Suman Bai on bail.
